name: status_month
description: First day of the month the status applies to. Status is evaluated at 00:00 on this date.

name: loyalty_tier
description: Cymbal Compass tier: none, blue, silver or gold.

name: loyalty_status
description: active (confirmed booking in the 12 months before status_month), lapsed (booked before that but not in the last 12 months) or never.

name: days_since_last_booking
description: Days from the most recent confirmed booking to status_month. NULL when the customer had never booked.

name: lifetime_bookings_to_date
description: Confirmed bookings on record before status_month.
